claims.claim: CONTINUE refreshes a safely stale-behind main before parsing malformed or older valid local TASK content and derives state from the synchronized TASK.
Missing-TASK synchronization remains compatible, while equal clean main proceeds through ordinary Unified State continuation without mutation.
Equal, local-ahead, diverged, and dirty valid TASK states retain observable Unified Human behavior without destructive Git operations.
Detached and unconfigured non-main states preserve established fail-closed operator errors while prohibiting repository mutation, RUN creation, Executor invocation, and fallback integration.
Synchronization-changing continuation restarts exactly once before TASK parsing and Unified State observation, with loop protection.
Read-only state and direct lifecycle commands retain their existing synchronization and authority boundaries.
The repair changes only the authorized Operator regression tests and preserves the original TASK implementation and documentation.
